text:
sanjay: noticing a burst of 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference in eu-west2 (az3) starting ~11:45UTC, multiple customer escalations. top-level alert: 503 gateway + upstream timeouts. any quick wins? :eyes:

lina: seeing same in dashboards — 503 spike + request latency > 3s for short requests. error_id samples: req_9c3f, req_a2b1, req_fd22.

alex: can you paste a couple of raw request_ids + timestamps from customers? I'll grep logs.

maria: customer sent these: "req_9c3f 2026-03-16T11:46:12Z example.com/api/v1/generate" and "req_fd22 2026-03-16T11:46:30Z". They reported retries and increased billing due to retries.

cs_bot: forwarded to #incidents: Customer CS ticket 9241 — repeated 502/503, app-level retries happening, high RPS at 11:45-11:50.

alex: grepping now... matching logs show upstream timeouts to inference runtime in az3 with lots of TCP retransmits. snippet: ```tcpdump: 12 retransmits, cwnd drops, rtt spiking 200-600ms```

lina: I ran quick latency histograms by pod and saw tail latencies only in az3; az1/az2 normal. Could be inter-AZ path or local edge.

netops-bot: detected packet loss spike on peering path ASN 64536 -> 0.9% loss at 11:44-11:48. Reported to provider.

tim: can we repro quickly from our infra? from a jumpbox in eu-west2-az3: `curl -v --max-time 3 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` returns 503 intermittently. Added `--trace-ascii trace.txt` and saw `recv timeout after 3 seconds`.

alex: ran traceroute from az3->edge egress, seeing a hop with 150-300ms spikes and occasional * at hop 6 (transit provider). paste: ```traceroute to edge (10.23.45.1), 6  provider-gw  120 ms  *  210 ms```

maria: customers noted auth errors during same window (some 502s surfaced as auth failures). That matches retry storm -> token check overhead -> billing.

lina: immediate mitigation: shift traffic for hosted api in eu-west2 away from az3 using routing policy for 10m to see impact. should we flip canary routing to az1/az2?

netops-bot: recommended BGP community to de-preference transit path for az3 to force alternate peering. Opening ticket with provider: TKT-5519.

sanjay: please execute weighted routing change (10% -> 0% az3, 50/50 az1/az2), monitor errors and costs. make sure rate-limiting not to blame.

alex: applied routing change at 11:58UTC. pushing logs now.

cs_bot: updated customers that we are investigating; asked them to share request_ids for any new errors.

lina: after reroute metrics improving: 503 rate down ~78% in 7m, tail latency stabilized. az3 still has some intermittent drops but much less traffic now.

maria: billing ops: alarm — retry volume increased 4x during spike window; customers may see bumps. tracking for credits.

tim: captured tcpdump sample and attached minimal pcap: ```loss pattern: bursts of 10-20 packets every 30s, significant retransmit count -> causes server timeouts```

alex: provider responded: noticed micro-congestion on egress link in their POP causing queueing and packet drops, mitigation: changed QoS and withdrew route for a few minutes while we rerouted. provider confirms lower loss after 12:05UTC.

netops-bot: provider TKT-5519 updated: QoS tweak and temporary de-preference in place, monitoring 24h.

sanjay: root cause hypothesis: transient provider POP congestion -> packet loss and TCP retransmits -> increased request latency and upstream timeouts -> retries -> billing impact.

lina: next actions: 1) schedule postmortem + timeline, 2) add automatic short-circuit to avoid retries escalating billing (de-dup/backoff), 3) add healthcheck routing rule to detect AZ-level egress issues and cut weight faster.

maria: I'll draft customer-facing note and credit plan; cc billing & support.

tim: putting a small repro script in runbook for oncall to quickly check packet loss pattern: ```#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health" || echo "connerr"; sleep 3; done```

alex: recording incident tag INC-2026-0423-euw2-az3-pktloss, postmortem owner: lina. will add logs and pcap to the incident.

sanjay: thanks everyone. please file follow-ups in tasks: auto-rollout for reroute logic, billing credit review, and provider SLA escalation if recurring.

cs_bot: customer ticket 9241 updated with mitigation steps and ETA for credit review.

lina: marking thread for postmortem notes. closing active triage. :white_check_mark:
